messages:
leah: Heads up — seeing a small spike in GPU attach failures in us-central around 01:12 UTC. Mounts failing with I/O errors.
omar: Logs point to nvme0 on several gnodes showing timeout + firmware retries.
tess: quick dmesg excerpt from node gnode-402:
```
[Sun May 09 01:11:58] nvme0: I/O 44211 QID 6 timeout
[Sun May 09 01:11:59] nvme0: timeout waiting for completion
[Sun May 09 01:12:01] nvme0: SMART reassigning LBA range +1
[Sun May 09 01:12:04] blk_update_request: I/O error, dev nvme0n1, sector 509328
```
kevin: Correlates with a scrub window overlap + a scheduled ML batch job that does many small checkpoints. IOPS headroom likely blown.
sre-bot: [alert] nvme_reassign_threshold exceeded on gnode-402 (warning).
leah: Can we throttle the cleaner on affected AZ and add a temporary attach-deprioritize for nodes with reassign growth?
omar: Throttle strategy: reduce cleaner concurrency from 10 -> 3 and add 10-15m jitter across AZs. Also set blkio limits for cleaner to 400 iops.
tess: I can push a canary to 3 nodes in us-central and run a small training batch to reproduce.
ops-janet: Note on replacements: if SMART deltas keep trending, we'll want to budget replacements next quarter. Replacement ops per rack ~ $5-7k and need maintenance windows.
kevin: Also propose a short-term firmware-friendly tweak: switch cleaner to read-first verification mode (less write amplification) during peak GPU launches.
leah: Good call. Plan: 1) run 3-node canary (tess) 2) deploy concurrency + blkio throttle if canary looks stable (omar/kevin) 3) implement auto-deprioritize heuristic (kevin) 4) ops to track SMART and schedule replacements if needed (ops-janet).
tess: Canary started. Monitoring iowait, attach success, and SMART.
kevin: I'll add a dashboard panel for reassign_count vs attach_fail rate and an alert when reassign_count per node > 2 and attach_fail > 5%.
sre-bot: [update] canary nodes report attach success increasing from 83% -> 97% after throttle.
ops-janet: If rollout holds, ops recommends cluster-wide roll tomorrow during low-traffic window to avoid further SLA impact. Finance notified for CAPEX contingency.
leah: Thanks team — keeping this active until we confirm rollout. Dropping links: https://git.internal/ops/cleaner/patch-readfirst and https://git.internal/ops/configs/blkio-throttle.toml :thumbsup:
